core_invariant.name: SOURCE_GROUNDED_QUESTION_INVARIANT
core_invariant.statement: Every factual claim, numeric value, unit, quantity meaning, semantic relation, premise, answer claim, explanation claim, and required reasoning step in a generated question must be traceable to approved original source evidence.
requirements: Every factual claim must map to approved source evidence.
Every numeric value must map to approved source evidence.
Every unit must map to approved source evidence.
Every quantity meaning must map to approved source evidence.
Every relation used in reasoning must map to approved source evidence.
Every required reasoning step must map to approved Source Units.
No unstated premise may be invented.
No external fact may be introduced unless explicitly permitted by contract.
No external formula may be introduced unless explicitly permitted by contract.
No external law may be introduced unless explicitly permitted by contract.
No external constant may be introduced unless explicitly permitted by contract.
No source-supported number may be reassigned to another semantic quantity.
No unsupported initial value may be invented to manufacture a calculation.
Structural validity never overrides source-grounding failure.

coherent_evidence_rule.principle: QG must reason over a semantically coherent evidence bundle, not arbitrary isolated fragments.
requirements: Approved geometry components are evidence boundaries, not proof of semantic completeness.
Component authorization does not prove semantic coherence.
Same page does not prove semantic relation.
Same context_code does not prove semantic relation.
Same lesson or chapter does not prove semantic relation.
The evidence bundle must preserve the reading context required to interpret facts correctly.
If selected fragments omit necessary bridging content, generation must be blocked.
The model must not invent missing semantic bridges.

number_unit_quantity_rule.principle: Numeric grounding requires value + quantity meaning + unit/context + source evidence. Matching a number alone is insufficient.
requirements: A number may only be used with its source-supported semantic quantity.
A ratio may not become an absolute quantity without source-supported absolute data.
A count, frequency, thickness, ratio, angle, time, distance, probability or other quantity must retain its semantic type.
A computed value is allowed only when all operands and operations are source-authorized.
If any required operand is invented, the numeric reasoning chain fails.

conditions.M1: Each selected Source Unit is sufficiently interpretable within the coherent evidence bundle.
conditions.M2: The semantic relation between Source Units is explicit or directly derivable from original evidence.
conditions.M3: The intended question genuinely requires the cross-source relation.
conditions.M4: No missing semantic bridge is invented by the model.
conditions.M5: No numeric value, unit, or quantity is reassigned across semantic meanings.
conditions.M6: Sources are not stitched together solely to manufacture cognitive difficulty.
conditions.M7: The complete minimum solution path can be reconstructed from approved evidence.
conditions.M8: Removing a Source Unit declared as necessary makes the intended solution incomplete.

requirements: The requested cognitive level must arise naturally from source-supported relations.
Do not invent data to satisfy APPLY.
Do not invent relations to satisfy ADVANCED.
Do not force multi-source composition when a coherent simpler source is more natural.
If the requested cognitive level is unsupported, return HOLD_NO_VALID_SOURCE_SET.

failure_codes.UNSUPPORTED_FACT: Candidate fact is unsupported by approved evidence.
failure_codes.UNSUPPORTED_NUMERIC_FACT: Candidate numeric value has no approved source support.
failure_codes.UNSUPPORTED_UNIT: Candidate unit has no approved source support.
failure_codes.QUANTITY_MEANING_MISMATCH: A source-supported number is reused as another quantity.
failure_codes.MISSING_SEMANTIC_BRIDGE: Composition requires a bridge absent from approved evidence.
failure_codes.ARTIFICIAL_MULTI_SOURCE_COMPOSITION: Fragments were combined merely to manufacture difficulty.
failure_codes.INCOMPLETE_COHERENT_EVIDENCE: Approved evidence lacks necessary continuous semantic context.
failure_codes.COGNITIVE_LEVEL_NOT_SOURCE_SUPPORTED: Requested cognitive level is not naturally supported.
failure_codes.HOLD_NO_VALID_SOURCE_SET: No valid grounded source set supports the requested item.

sourceguard_integration.architecture: Container → Object → ReadingRegion → Anchor → ReadingLane → RegionGrowing → Validation → Render
sourceguard_integration.source_truth: Original page / frozen Source Unit / approved evidence crop
